The I2C_WR instruction performs the following operations, see Figure 2.7-2.
Master sends slave address, with r/w bit set to 0 ("write").
Slave address is obtained from SENS_I2C_SLAVE_ADDR
Master generates a repeated START (RSTART) signal.
Master sends slave address, with r/w bit set to 0 ("write").
Master sends one byte of data.
Master checks whether the number of transmitted bytes reaches the number set by the current instruction (byte_num).
If yes, master jumps out of the write instruction and starts the next instruction.
Otherwise the master repeats Step 8 and sends the next byte.
Master generates a STOP signal and stops the transmission.
